description: List campaigns, optionally filtered by names and/or program_names.
embedding_description: List the Marketo Smart Campaigns configured in this instance, optionally filtered by exact campaign name or parent program name — use this to discover a campaign's id before calling trigger_campaign. Distinct from list_static_lists (lead segments) and trigger_campaign (which runs one).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with records (a list of campaign dicts: id, name, type, programName, ...) + row_count + spilled=false inline, OR result_blob_key + row_count + spilled=true when large.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the row_count and list campaign names + ids.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List campaigns from the configured Marketo instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Read-Only Campaign. marketo.rate_limited: API rate limit exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the OAuth client_id/client_secret. marketo.permission_denied: run check_setup to see the exact missing Role permission.
